_note: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the draft board's Ideal-players tags. Edit THIS file, not the HTML: Board/draft-board.html embeds a verbatim copy of this document as the JS const IDEAL_BOARD_SEED (no fetch, so it works over file:// and GitHub Pages alike). At boot the board merges these tags into localStorage state.tags, and localStorage stays Hai's live in-draft scratch layer -- his hand-set values ALWAYS win. Mechanically: a JSON tag is applied only when the key is absent from state.tags, or when state.tags[key] is still exactly the value we last seeded (tracked in state.idealSeeded). Any value Hai set himself -- including a deliberate untag, which persists as null -- is left alone and never re-seeded. Notes are written only when there is no note, or when the existing note carries one of our own generated prefixes. tag:null means 'we previously seeded this key and are now retiring that call'; it clears the tag rather than leaving a stale one behind. Deliberately partial: ~30 entries, weighted to the Active edge board. Everything else is left untagged on purpose so Hai fills it in live.

Brock Purdy|QB.note: Reclassified target->value 2026-09-05 because the case is entirely a price one: two independent Tier-1 rankings (NFL.com #9, PFF #10) against ADP 115 vs consensus #92 -- a 23-spot discount, the widest legitimate gap on the Active board once you exclude the structural late-round-QB artifact. Josh Downs|WR.label: Value
Josh Downs|WR.note: Pure price gap with a fresh mechanism behind it: ADP 119 against consensus #86 is a 33-spot discount, and the IND quarterback question that suppressed the whole passing game just resolved to Daniel Jones (Colts.com, 2026-09-03) -- the same resolution that prices Jonathan Taylor up. Chig Okonkwo|TE.note: Won the WAS move-TE role outright at a TE19/streamer price -- ADP 201, ESPN 219. Matthew Golden|WR.label: Sleeper
Matthew Golden|WR.note: Justified hype rather than empty: on-field pecking-order reporting (not teammate quotes) has him taking starting outside reps opposite Christian Watson with Doubs and Wicks both gone, roughly 131 vacated targets. Dylan Sampson|RB.label: Sleeper
Dylan Sampson|RB.note: Locked passing-down role behind Judkins at effectively zero cost: ADP 170 against consensus #144. Standalone PPR dart plus a genuine handcuff on the same ticket.
